content.title: How To Watch The Laguna Beach Reunion In Australia
content.text: Let's go back... The Reunion: Laguna Beach Official Trailer0 seconds of 1 minute, 52 secondsVolume 0% THE RUNDOWN The Laguna Beach Reunion is airing on April 10 in the US. There is no current streaming partner in Australia, but there are still ways to legally watch the special from Australia. Let’s go back. Back to the beginning. Back to when Laguna Beach was giving Australians a glimpse into the real lives of the teenagers who lived in Orange County, California. Finally, more than 20 years after the reality show aired, the original cast has returned to their home town to film a reunion special. And yes, it’s probably going to be exactly as emotional and fun as we’re all hoping. Though it might be hard to imagine now, when Laguna Beach premiered back in 2004, it was genuinely new and ground breaking. To date, there had only been series like The Real World and Big Brother, where strangers were thrown into an artificial setting and filmed as they navigated the many challenges that came with it. With the debut of Laguna Beach (and The Hills after it), a new era of reality television began. It even inspired the first ever season of The Real Housewives, with The Real Housewives of Orange County debuting in 2006. In short, the teenagers of Laguna Beach walked, so The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives could run. Here’s everything you need to know about the two-hour Laguna Beach reunion special. Which Cast Members Are Returning For The Laguna Beach Reunion? Excitingly, the original cast is returning for the reunion. Lauren Conrad, Stephen Colletti, Kristin Cavallari, Trey Phillips, Talan Torriero, Christina Schuller, Dieter Schmitz, Jessica Smith, Alex Hooser, and Morgan Olsen are all reuniting for the first time to relive their most iconic moments. Lo Bosworth was heavily pregnant at the time of filming but has confirmed that she will be involved in some capacity, remotely from her home in New York City. Image: MTV As for who’s behind the camera, original series creator Liz Gateley serves as executive producer alongside Conrad, Colletti, and Cavallari. Watch The Trailer For The Laguna Beach Reunion Naturally, Cavallari and Conrad are at the heart of the reunion, with Colletti also being an important addition. In the trailer for the reunion, we can catch glimpses of how the reunion might look, with a combination of old clips and discussions about said clips interspersed with newer moments shared by the cast, all set to the original Hilary Duff theme song ‘Come Clean’. And yes, of course they head down to the beach for a bonfire, and yes, it’s incredibly nostalgic. When Does The Laguna Beach Reunion Come Out? The two-hour Laguna Beach reunion special will come out on April 10, 2026 in the US, airing on the Roku Channel. Where To Watch The Laguna Beach Reunion In Australia? The special streams exclusively on The Roku Channel, which is free to access in the US via Roku devices, smart TVs, and the Roku web or mobile app. For Australian viewers, a VPN set to a US location is currently the only way to access it. A local streaming deal — potentially through Paramount+ — may be announced down the track. We’ll update this article when we know more.
